column2: Paste before every Image Description: "Stylized fantasy game UI element for a whimsical, expressive young-adult indie RPG card game with painterly card art. Painterly but CRISP: clean bold shapes, sharp readable edges, soft cel-shaded lighting from the upper left. Materials: warm parchment, polished dark wood, and brushed brass/gold trim, ornate but never cluttered. Viewed straight-on (orthographic, no perspective, no tilt). Fully transparent background (PNG with alpha) outside the element. Any area meant for text or content is left plain and empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no icons unless described." Then apply the Path accent if the row names a Path: Beefcake = sunny gold and warm red, iron and rope details; Necrocrat = cool grays and sickly green, filigree and seals; Gourmand = cream, copper and pastry tones, polished cookware details; Refusemancer = mossy greens and rust orange, vines and rivets; Colorless = neutral stone and parchment.

Save each image as its ID (e.g. UI-FRAME-B.png) and move approved images to Card Game Art / Approved_UI. Panels and buttons are '9-slice' elements: decoration lives in the corners and edges, the center is plain, so the game can stretch them to any size without distorting the corners. Button hover/pressed states are generated in-game from the base image.
